summary: Verified the two contrast fixes on the Business Technology Assessment results screen (data-testid='assessment-results') via full end-to-end Playwright run: intro -> 7 assessment steps -> contact form -> results. Confirmed via computed-style extraction that all category status colors on results render as rgb(234,179,8) (#eab308 gold/yellow), with NO occurrence of the old amber/orange (#f59e0b) anywhere on the results screen. EfficiencyForecast disclaimer note now renders at full opacity (#c0cfe0, not /40) and is clearly legible. Landed all 6 categories in the 'Developing' (50%) band and visually confirmed score ring label, 6-score grid cards, Top Gaps score numbers, Full Breakdown bars/%, and closing white CTA card all look correctly readable. No regression found in intro/question/contact steps.
